description: This file contains service functions for managing marketplace templates, including fetching, deleting, and saving custom templates, as well as retrieving predefined templates from various marketplace directories. It interacts with the filesystem, database, and other services to handle templates for chatflows, tools, and agent flows.

methods.name: getAllTemplates
methods.description: Fetches all templates from marketplace directories, including chatflows, tools, and agent flows, sorts them, and returns the list.

methods.name: deleteCustomTemplate
methods.description: Deletes a custom template from the database based on template ID and workspace ID.

methods.name: _modifyTemplates
methods.description: Internal function to parse and modify template objects, especially handling JSON fields and setting categories.

methods.name: getAllCustomTemplates
methods.description: Retrieves all custom templates for a workspace, including shared templates, and applies modifications.

methods.name: saveCustomTemplate
methods.description: Saves a new or updated custom template, handling flow data export and framework determination.

methods.name: _generateExportFlowData
methods.description: Generates export JSON and determines framework type based on node tags within flow data.
